Dear Sir/ Madam,  
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, 
including amendments thereunder and in continuation of earlier communication vide letter dated

Day, Date and Time 
Nature of
